Messages.Author: cantila
Messages.Body:
I'm really not used to these new rules for melee weapon...

1) If Thetmes strikes with a Bastard Sword, is the damage aggravated?
(I'd guess no since it's not a hand strike)

2) If a Husamettin strikes with Contract and has a Bastard Sword, does
the Sword ciunt for damage? The strike says +3 hand damage, so I guess
not?

3) Husamettin has Depravity, and a Bastard Sword that he strikes with,
does he do extra damage with Depravity? What if it was Parnassus
striking?

4)He plays Torn Sign Post and then uses a Bastard Sword, does he do 2+1
damage?

5) Same as all questions above, but instead of using a Bastard Sword he
has a Bang Nakh?

6) Shouldn't Depravity actually say +1 strength and not hand damage,
what about the inherent +1 hand damage that Parnassus have? Should it
be read as "+1 strength"?

Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
cantila wrote:
>
> I'm really not used to these new rules for melee weapon...
>
> 1) If Thetmes strikes with a Bastard Sword, is the damage aggravated?
> (I'd guess no since it's not a hand strike)

You guess correctly. Thetmes' hand damage is aggravated. Hand damage
is only damage from a hand strike - damage from a weapon strike is
not "hand damage".

> 2) If a Husamettin strikes with [K: Honor] and has a Bastard Sword, does

> the Sword ciunt for damage? The strike says +3 hand damage, so I guess
> not?

You guess correctly. Striking with Khabar: Honor is different than striking
with a weapon.

> 3) Husamettin has Depravity, and a Bastard Sword that he strikes with,
> does he do extra damage with Depravity? What if it was Parnassus
> striking?

Yes. Bastard Sword deals damage based on the striking minion's strength.
(See on-line card texts for the above cards).

> 4)He plays Torn Sign Post and then uses a Bastard Sword, does he do 2+1
> damage?

Yes.

> 5) Same as all questions above, but instead of using a Bastard Sword he
> has a Bang Nakh?

Bang Nakh deals damage based on the striking minion's strength.

> 6) Shouldn't Depravity actually say +1 strength and not hand damage,

Yes, see the on-line text.

> what about the inherent +1 hand damage that Parnassus have? Should it
> be read as "+1 strength"?

Yes, see the on-line text.
